title: Personal Agent — user.persona_core Record
description: Schema for the user.persona_core pack (#2 of 14): stable preferences, avoidances, priorities, values, and durable work patterns of the subject (PersonaTrait node). Each record extends the unified base record via allOf and is fed by PersonaTraitCandidate (see spec/01-kernel-schema.md §6 routing). Pack definition: ../spec/03-pack-catalog.md. Gate G4 applies: state observed behavior, not guessed psychology.

record_type.description: Persona-core record kind. PreferenceRecord = a stable thing the subject favors; AvoidanceRecord = a stable thing the subject avoids/dislikes; PriorityRecord = what the subject puts first when forced to choose; ValueRecord = a durable principle the subject reasons from; StablePatternRecord = a recurring, non-prescriptive behavioral tendency.

polarity.description: Direction of the trait. Typically favor for Preference/Priority/Value, avoid for Avoidance, and either for StablePattern. Optional; statement remains the canonical form.

trait_dimension.description: Optional short axis label this trait sits on (e.g. 'verbosity', 'risk_tolerance', 'formality', 'autonomy'). Helps cluster related records without inventing per-record vocabulary.

stability.description: How resistant the trait is to context. situational = often overridden by scope; durable/core = held across most contexts. Distinct from confidence (evidence strength); a trait can be high-confidence yet situational.

supersedes_preference.description: Other persona_core record ids this one wins over when two traits conflict at runtime (e.g. a PriorityRecord that overrides a PreferenceRecord). Resolution hint only; does not bypass review_status gates.

trigger_contexts.description: Concrete situations where the trait was observed to surface (e.g. 'tight deadline', 'public artifact', 'first draft'). Narrows scope without weakening it; supports Gate G2.

$comment: required = base required + record_type only (no extra mandatory fields, per pack-focus rule). All persona-core additions are optional. Base validation still applies: evidence_refs ≥ 1 (G1), non-empty scope (G2), counterexamples required when confidence < 0.7, exception_rules required when sensitivity ∈ {sensitive, restricted}. Display aliases for `statement`: 'preference'/'value'/'priority' may be shown in UIs but the stored field is `statement`.
